sources.title: KITTI Dataset | open-mmlab/OpenPCDet | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: 1. Introduction to KITTI Dataset The KITTI dataset is a widely used benchmark in autonomous driving research, providing LiDAR point clouds, camera images, and calibration information with 3D object annotations. In OpenPCDet, it's implemented through the KittiDataset class, which handles dataset loading, processing, and evaluation.
